scope: stationary nondegenerate Gaussian sequence with covariance tending to zero
reproduction: Bivariate normal covariance decay implies indicator covariance c_h=Cov(1_{X_1<-rho},1_{X_{1+h}<-rho}) tends to zero. For p=Phi(-rho/sigma)>0, Var(N^-1 sum I_n)=p(1-p)/N+(2/N^2)sum_{h<N}(N-h)c_h tends to zero by splitting at fixed H then H to infinity. Chebyshev makes every all-zero tail event probability zero; their countable union is the event of finitely many negatives.
remaining_gap: No finite-volume exceedance rate is obtained; covariance decay is essential.

scope: additive Gaussian density of w544 auxiliary model only
reproduction: Integrating f_delta_rho=rho^2 |k|^(2-s)/(beta a) over the cutoff disk gives rho^2 Lambda^(4-s)/[2 pi beta a(4-s)]. This positive finite density is L1, so covariance decays by Riemann-Lebesgue and N01 applies on a fixed spaced ray. A finite sum of nonnegative smoothing kernels is pointwise nonnegative, giving an incompatible one-point law.
remaining_gap: Does not exclude nonlinear or local fluctuation approximations or an actual Riesz hexatic phase.
